home.title: ModeDock: screen controls in your Mac's menu bar
home.description: ModeDock is a free, open-source menu-bar app for macOS. It controls your screens, brightness, display profiles, Keep Awake and screenshots.
home.heading: Every screen control in your menu bar.
home.sub: Control your screens, brightness, display profiles, Keep Awake and screenshots from one menu-bar app.
home.meta: Free and open source · macOS 14 or later · Open it with <kbd>⌃⌥⌘M</kbd>
home.heroAlt: The ModeDock panel: each screen with its resolution, brightness and power button

screens.title: Screens
screens.text: Every screen in one place, built-in and external.
points: Turn a screen off and on, or put a monitor in standby
Change resolution and refresh rate, including ones macOS hides
Set brightness on external monitors too
Switch a monitor's input, the main screen and mirroring

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.text: Save how your screens are set up and switch back in one click.
points: Which screens are on, their resolution and brightness
Dark Mode, Night Shift, True Tone and Hide Dock, if you want
Applied on its own when the same screens connect
A shortcut to step through them

power.title: Keep Awake
power.text: Keep your Mac awake for a set time or until you turn it off.
points: Let the screens sleep or keep them on
Sleep the Mac or lock the screen

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.text: Capture an area, a window, a screen or all screens. Save to a folder, the clipboard or both.
points: HDR and the pointer, if you want them

utilities.title: Quick switches
utilities.text: Settings that are normally a few clicks away.
points: Dark Mode, Night Shift, True Tone, Hide Dock
Desktop icons and hidden files in Finder
Empty the Trash, eject every disk

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.text: Set a shortcut for almost anything.

layout.title: Your layout
layout.text: Choose what the panel shows, and copy your setup to another Mac.

exit.title: Clean exit
exit.text: When you quit, every screen turns back on and any dimming is undone.

open.title: Open source
open.text: MIT license. The code is on GitHub.

private.title: Private
private.text: Nothing is sent unless you opt in. Then it's only anonymous counts. Privacy
